items.item_text: Certification as Registered Dietitian by the Commission of Dietetic Registration.

The Neuropsychiatric Hospital (NPH) at Mid-Wilshire is seeking a Per Diem Dietitian to join the Department of Nutrition. You will provide medical nutrition therapy to inpatients across a range of specialized clinical areas, supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, patient-centered care.
Assessment, documentation, implementation, monitoring, and reassessment of patients' nutrition care plans
Conducting nutritional assessments, diet calculations, and provision of medical nutrition therapy
Performing patient education, malnutrition screening, and nutrition-focused physical exams (NFPE)
Providing ongoing education to patients and/or family members
Charting in EPIC and utilizing Computation
This is a part-time, as-needed per diem position; schedule and working hours will vary. Position may convert to career.
Please note: This role requires flexibility to float across locations during the training period.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Excellent computer and customer service skills.
Strong knowledge in malnutrition diagnosing and NFPE
Availability to work weekends and holidays.
